subject.title: Allow before_agent_start hooks to override prompt

question: Should installed plugins be granted a public, policy-gated ability to replace the user-authored prompt, and if so should that authority live in before_prompt_build with legacy before_agent_start adapted only for compatibility?
rationale: This is an additive plugin SDK capability that can redact or truncate user intent before provider submission, so implementation cannot safely choose its authority, precedence, and security/audit contract without maintainer direction.

options.title: Approve a typed replacement contract
options.body: Add one policy-gated replacement field to before_prompt_build, define precedence and audit behavior, and carry it through every supported harness.

options.title: Keep hooks additive
options.body: Retain prepend/append and system-context mutation only, directing redaction or truncation to another explicit host-owned seam.

options.title: Defer pending a broader prompt-policy design
options.body: Pause the request until maintainers define a unified contract for prompt mutation, provenance, and plugin trust boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve a typed replacement contract
recommendation.body: Add one policy-gated replacement field to before_prompt_build, define precedence and audit behavior, and carry it through every supported harness.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin-hook contract history most directly covers the shared API and merger decisions required here.
